sources.title: executive Archives – Math Corps
sources.excerpt: Did you know? Octopuses have three hearts, and their blood is blue!

reasoning: The claim is factually accurate. Octopuses have three hearts: two branchial hearts that pump blood through the gills to receive oxygen, and one systemic heart that pumps the oxygenated blood throughout the rest of the body. Their blood is blue because it uses a copper-rich protein called hemocyanin to transport oxygen, unlike the iron-based hemoglobin found in human and mammalian red blood cells.
